entries.title: Hosea 2:1
segments: ¶Say to your brethren, 'My people,' And to your sisters, 'Mercy [is shown].'

entries.title: Hosea 2:2
segments: "Bring charges against your mother, bring charges; For she [is] not My wife, nor [am] I her Husband! Let her put away her harlotries from her sight, And her adulteries from between her breasts;

entries.title: Hosea 2:3
segments: Lest I strip her naked And expose her, as in the day she was born, And make her like a wilderness, And set her like a dry land, And slay her with thirst.

entries.title: Hosea 2:4
segments: "I will not have mercy on her children, For they [are] the children of harlotry.

entries.title: Hosea 2:5
segments: For their mother has played the harlot; She who conceived them has behaved shamefully. For she said, 'I will go after my lovers, Who give [me] my bread and my water, My wool and my linen, My oil and my drink.'

entries.title: Hosea 2:6
segments: ¶"Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, And wall her in, So that she cannot find her paths.

entries.title: Hosea 2:7
segments: She will chase her lovers, But not overtake them; Yes, she will seek them, but not find [them]. Then she will say, 'I will go and return to my first husband, For then [it was] better for me than now.'

entries.title: Hosea 2:8
segments: For she did not know That I gave her grain, new wine, and oil, And multiplied her silver and gold-[Which] they prepared for Baal.

entries.title: Hosea 2:9
segments: "Therefore I will return and take away My grain in its time And My new wine in its season, And will take back My wool and My linen, [Given] to cover her nakedness.

entries.title: Hosea 2:10
segments: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, And no one shall deliver her from My hand.

entries.title: Hosea 2:11
segments: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, Her feast days, Her New Moons, Her Sabbaths-All her appointed feasts.

entries.title: Hosea 2:12
segments: "And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, Of which she has said, 'These [are] my wages that my lovers have given me.' So I will make them a forest, And the beasts of the field shall eat them.

entries.title: Hosea 2:13
segments: I will punish her For the days of the Baals to which she burned incense. She decked herself with her earrings and jewelry, And went after her lovers; But Me she forgot," says the LORD.

entries.title: Hosea 2:14
segments: ¶"Therefore, behold, I will allure her, Will bring her into the wilderness, And speak comfort to her.

entries.title: Hosea 2:15
segments: I will give her her vineyards from there, And the Valley of Achor as a door of hope; She shall sing there, As in the days of her youth, As in the day when she came up from the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 2:16
segments: "And it shall be, in that day," Says the LORD, "[That] you will call Me 'My Husband,' And no longer call Me 'My Master,'

entries.title: Hosea 2:17
segments: For I will take from her mouth the names of the Baals, And they shall be remembered by their name no more.

entries.title: Hosea 2:18
segments: In that day I will make a covenant for them With the beasts of the field, With the birds of the air, And [with] the creeping things of the ground. Bow and sword of battle I will shatter from the earth, To make them lie down safely.

entries.title: Hosea 2:19
segments: "I will betroth you to Me forever; Yes, I will betroth you to Me In righteousness and justice, In lovingkindness and mercy;

entries.title: Hosea 2:20
segments: I will betroth you to Me in faithfulness, And you shall know the LORD.

entries.title: Hosea 2:21
segments: "It shall come to pass in that day [That] I will answer," says the LORD; "I will answer the heavens, And they shall answer the earth.

entries.title: Hosea 2:22
segments: The earth shall answer With grain, With new wine, And with oil; They shall answer Jezreel.

entries.title: Hosea 2:23
segments: Then I will sow her for Myself in the earth, And I will have mercy on [her who had] not obtained mercy; Then I will say to [those who were] not My people, 'You [are]  My people!' And they shall say, '[You are] my God!'"
